sections.introduction: Swarna Suryavarti Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from them mixture of fruitful minerals. This formulation is helpful to treat problems related with spleen, liver and mental problems.
sections.ingredients:
Swarna Bhasma – Gold calx 
 Suddha Hartala – Purified Arsenic Tri Oxide 
 Hema Makshika Bhasma – Copper iron sulphide calx 
 Vanga Bhasma – Tin calx 
 Rajata Bhasma – Silver calx 
 Suddha Manashila  
 Kanthaloha Bhasma – Magnetic iron calx 
 Naga Bhasma – Calcinated lead 
 Abhraka Bhasma – Calcinated mica calx 
 Pravala Bhasma – Coral calx 
 Vaikranta Bhasma – Tourmaline calx 
 Mouktika Bhasma – Pearl Oyster Shell Calx 
 Shilajit – Asphaltum 

 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are mixed together to prepare this formulation. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Swarna Suryavarti Rasa is an effective Ayurvedic formulation that provides healing effects in various conditions. 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is an effective remedy for illnesses related to gastrointestinal system. It provides relief from problems of chronic nausea, facilitate to control vomiting, effective in dyspepsia, correct indigestion problem, improves digestion and relieves other symptoms as well as suitable remedy for gastritis, reduces inflammation in stomach lining and relieves pain and burning sensation in chest. It is suitable and beneficial in bilious ailments too, quiet efficient in managing other diseases linked to liver, helps to remove toxins out of the body, thus can manage jaundice, as it can promote the healthy secretion of the bile and provides beneficial effects in spleen disorders along. It is even useful in mental disorders as in depression, improves the condition of the patient. Very effective in mental and physical stress.

Swarna Suryavarti Rasa 
 Introduction 
 Swarna Suryavarti Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from them mixture of fruitful minerals. This formulation is helpful to treat problems related with spleen, liver and mental problems. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Swarna Bhasma – Gold calx 
 Suddha Hartala – Purified Arsenic Tri Oxide 
 Hema Makshika Bhasma – Copper iron sulphide calx 
 Vanga Bhasma – Tin calx 
 Rajata Bhasma – Silver calx 
 Suddha Manashila  
 Kanthaloha Bhasma – Magnetic iron calx 
 Naga Bhasma – Calcinated lead 
 Abhraka Bhasma – Calcinated mica calx 
 Pravala Bhasma – Coral calx 
 Vaikranta Bhasma – Tourmaline calx 
 Mouktika Bhasma – Pearl Oyster Shell Calx 
 Shilajit – Asphaltum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are mixed together to prepare this formulation. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Swarna Suryavarti Rasa is an effective Ayurvedic formulation that provides healing effects in various conditions. 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is an effective remedy for illnesses related to gastrointestinal system. It provides relief from problems of chronic nausea, facilitate to control vomiting, effective in dyspepsia, correct indigestion problem, improves digestion and relieves other symptoms as well as suitable remedy for gastritis, reduces inflammation in stomach lining and relieves pain and burning sensation in chest. It is suitable and beneficial in bilious ailments too, quiet efficient in managing other diseases linked to liver, helps to remove toxins out of the body, thus can manage jaundice, as it can promote the healthy secretion of the bile and provides beneficial effects in spleen disorders along. It is even useful in mental disorders as in depression, improves the condition of the patient. Very effective in mental and physical stress. 
 Indications 
 
 Vomiting 
 Nausea 
 Distaste 
 Bilious diseases 
 Jaundice 
 Liver disorders 
 Spleen disorders 
 Mental problems 
 
 Dose 
 200 mg two times a day. 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
